name: effort-router
description: Claude Code plugin: an MCP server that picks the model and reasoning effort for a task, and escalates when a session is stuck.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=plugin/dist/server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run validate
